item.title: Pistons snap Hornets' 9-game win streak with win in game marred by fight, ejections
item.description: The Detroit Pistons hung on to beat Charlotte on Monday night, snapping the Hornets' nine-game winning streak in a wild game that included a fight and four player ejections.

item.title: Community rallies to help family whose home was damaged after finding missing boy with autism
item.description: A Madison Heights family who found a missing 6-year-old boy with autism safe in their home is now receiving community support after their house sustained extensive water damage from the incident.

item.title: Woman dies after Dearborn house fire
item.description: A woman has died after a house caught fire Monday in Dearborn, officials say. The fire happened at a home near Lawrence Avenue and Drexel Street.
